queries: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), gender_shares AS (SELECT gender, invoice_count, invoice_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM gender_shares) SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
